D.t: Mark DeSaulnier leads by 53.0 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 139,890 votes; a one point swing is about 1,321 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +46.4 and D +58.8. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
